reviews.author: DANIEL KIM
reviews.text: The best campsite near metro vancouver. Close to the beautiful beach. Clean washroom. （中文要点：大温周边最好的营地，离美丽海滩近，洗手间干净）

reviews.author: D MK
reviews.text: Enjoyed our double campsite at Delta Grove. Site was very clean and had small beach/access to the lake off the back of our site which made the experience even better. Would stay at this campground again! （中文要点：Delta Grove 的双营位很干净，营位后面直接连小沙滩可下湖）

reviews.author: Shahrzad Jamali
reviews.text: I have been camping a few times a year every summer for the past few years and this campground was one of the worst experience! the bathroom/showers were extremely dirty all the time (the picture below was taken at 9 Am). The campground was very close to the road and noisy all the time! （中文要点：浴室/淋浴极其脏，营地离公路太近全天噪音大，近年最差的体验之一）

reviews.author: Adette Balot
reviews.text: Nice campground well maintain,with shower in there washroom. Nice view in the lake with different spot to relax. （中文要点：营地维护不错，洗手间有淋浴，湖景好、休息点多）

reviews.author: Chris Lidstone
reviews.text: Your site was right on the lake and it was fantastic! The site was quite level and spacious. The outhouse was better than most but not the best I have been in. Overall it has been great so far! （中文要点：湖畔营位绝佳，平坦宽敞；旱厕比多数营地好但不算顶尖）

reviews.author: Yolanda Yao
reviews.text: There are mice! Our tent has a living room area that does not fully zip, we hear mice running through at night, and leaving droppings. We are absolutely sure we did not have any food in the tent. We also had lights on the whole night, they still got in. Can barely sleep because of the sounds those rats were making. There are also looooots of caterpillars dropping from the tree, onto tent, table, and car. The washrooms are clean. Environment is peaceful. Close to trails and lake. Will not visit again! （中文要点：帐篷里有老鼠整夜吵闹（确认无食物在帐篷内），树上大量毛毛虫掉在帐篷车上，洗手间干净、环境安静但不会再来）

reviews.author: Julie Lorimer
reviews.text: My favorite campground in Cultus Lake - good sites, good amenities, friendly staff and Seven Sisters Trail starts right in the campground. （中文要点：Cultus Lake 最喜欢的营地，Seven Sisters 步道直接从营地内出发）

reviews.author: Jason Tribbiani
reviews.text: I'd rate this 4.5 out of 5. Everything was great except that the campsite is a bit too close to the street, so you can still hear cars passing by at night. That said, the site is very clean, well-organized, and conveniently located near the lake, Cultus Lake Water Park, and Adventure Park. There are a few trails in the area and plenty of shops nearby. Best of all, there's cell service here, which may be important to others (though I didn't mind either way). The highlight of our trip was getting lucky enough to witness the northern lights by Cultus Lake—it was truly amazing and saved me a few thousand dollars from a trip to Yellowknife! With that, I'm giving this trip a full 5 out of 5. It was the best and most memorable way to wrap up our summer vacation. （中文要点：营位离公路稍近夜晚能听到车声，但干净有序，离湖/水上乐园/冒险乐园近，有手机信号，还看到了极光，最终打5分）

reviews.author: Kay Ren
reviews.text: I can't tell you the biggest secret ... Or I will lose this spot next time. I just want to say I had the best site. It was spacious and clean. Best is that the place was level! No sliding off your air mattress cuz you set up your tent on a slope. We're were steps away from the garbage bins (no smell from where we stayed), the bathrooms (3 stalls and one shower. Can get busy at times and the hand dryer is quite loud. We can hear it from our site), potable water tap for all your water needs and the beach about a 6 min walk and across the street. Very doable with a wagon. Best thing about this park was how clean the Rangers kept the facility. I'm shocked. I didn't see any gross sights in the bathroom. Showers were kept nice. Just a stellar job from the parks board. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and like this campsite better than delta grove. Will come back next year and more! （中文要点：营位宽敞平坦干净，离垃圾桶/厕所/饮用水近，沙滩步行6分钟过马路即到，管理员维护极好，比 Delta Grove 更喜欢）

reviews.author: Alice R
reviews.text: Last summer was our first time camping in Delta Grove and its absolutely so beautiful. Its located right next to the lake and its a smaller campground than the other ones in Cultus. Less busy and easy access for our zodiac boat. We will book this campground again. Date of stay: July 2022. （中文要点：Delta Grove 紧邻湖，是 Cultus 四个营地中最小的，相对不拥挤，方便放橡皮艇）

reviews.author: KellyNagle
reviews.text: Very loud campground! Boats, kids, traffic, large groups. The lake side sites are beautiful and large trees are all over the place, but it is far from peaceful. Clear Creek campground on the other side of the main road had sites further up the hill away from the road and was overall much quieter, although it was also packed. Date of stay: August 2022. （中文要点：非常吵——船、孩子、交通、大团体；湖边营位美但远不宁静；马路对面的 Clear Creek 山上营位安静得多）

reviews.author: boonsdg
reviews.text: Great campgrounds but the road noise is unreal. I understand it's the only road through to the next town but good lord are the vehicles travelling the road majority jacked up loud trucks. 8 pm on a Saturday and 30 loud trucks in a row and that was just one row of vehicles. Even during the night we were woken up by extremely loud vehicles. Probably won't be coming back to this camp ground. Date of stay: June 2022. （中文要点：营地本身不错，但公路噪音离谱，周六晚上8点一排接一排的改装大卡车，半夜也被吵醒，可能不会再来）

reviews.author: Ding D
reviews.text: Cultus lake is very nice. But at almost $50 a night with all the fees etc, it is almost not worth it. Bathroom is extremely dirty, although I see many maintenance workers outside the washroom in the morning, I think they probably only change toilet paper and cleaning spider webs is not on the task list. If not for the lake, I probably would not come back anytime soon. Date of stay: July 2021. （中文要点：湖很美但含各种费用近50加元/晚不值；厕所极脏，维护工只换厕纸不清理蜘蛛网；若不是为了湖不会再来）

reviews.author: Heather F
reviews.text: We have stayed at Delta Grove for the past 4 years with a group of around 30 people occupying 7 or 8 different sites. Let's start by saying that this is a typical provincial park - there are no services other than a shower house with flush toilets, water taps and pit toilets. But being next to the lake during the heat of summer is amazing! The view is fabulous and floating around the lake on a floatie toy with a cold beer in hand.....well, it just doesn't get an better than that for relaxing. This season, with COVID19 being in the spotlight, we noticed a distinct change in the cleanliness of the campsites. The pit toilet by our campsite was only properly cleaned twice in the 9 days we camped. The was NEVER hand sanitizer even though there were signs telling you to use the non-existent hand sanitizer before and after using the toilet. Price of a small bundle of campfire wood was $12 and a bag of ice was $6.....take the 5 minute drive to the camp store down the road and pay half that amount for twice as much wood and $2 less for a bigger bag of ice. Campsites are old style, well spaced but small, and the ones close to the road are noisy. Other than that, a beautiful place to relax. Date of stay: July 2020. （中文要点：连续4年带30人大团体来；典型省立公园（仅淋浴房+冲水厕所+水龙头+旱厕）；疫情年旱厕9天只彻底清洁2次、洗手液一直没有；柴火营地$12/小捆，开车5分钟到营地商店买一半价格双倍量；靠公路的营位吵）

The campground is infested with mice, getting into RV trailer. Large amount of continuous traffic on road near campground, very noisy. If camping on outer loop near busy road, people park and walk through campsite to get to swim area. Will not return. Date of stay: July 2019. （中文要点：老鼠泛滥钻进拖挂车；靠公路外圈持续车流非常吵；外圈营位会被路人穿行抄近道去游泳区；不会再来）

Campsites are spaced apart for privacy with greenery on three sides. The fire pits are well designed with a small grate on top. Firewood is $12/bundle or $32 for three - bring cash, no burning of surounding wood allowed. Maple Bay cabins are available for rent in another area and they each have a queen bed and three singe beds (two on bottom level and one above with ladder), bring your own bedding supplies. No plumbing in cabins but there is an electic outlet and a covered picnic table just outside the door. No fire pits at cabins but you can rent a propane fire pit which is handy if there is a ban on campfires. Cultus Lake is very close to the cabins and the nearby washrooms have free showers and sinks to wash dishes. Date of stay: June 2020. （中文要点：营位三面有绿植、私密性好；柴火$12/捆、$32/3捆只收现金；Maple Bay 另有木屋出租（大床+三张单人床，无上下水有电源，可租丙烷火盆），附近洗手间有免费淋浴和洗碗槽）

reviews.author: T H
reviews.text: Great little site! The spaces are nice and secluded and separate from each other. Large enough for trailers. Quiet and peaceful. There are bathrooms with running water, flushing toilets and showers. It's about a 5 minute drive from the adventure park and places to run down for supplies if needed. We had full service on our phones so we just put them on airplain mode. Nice to know we had service in the event of an emergency. There's also a small beach just outside the Campground, but I can see it getting quite busy during peak hours. You could definitely walk to it though if you got a site close to the entrance to the park. Would highly recommend for those who enjoy having more amenities while camping. （中文要点：营位隐蔽互不干扰、能停拖挂、安静；有自来水/冲水厕所/淋浴；手机信号满格；营地外有个小沙滩，高峰时段会挤）

reviews.author: Salman G
reviews.text: We had a great stay at Clear Creek Campground! The washrooms were clean and well-maintained, with the added convenience of showers and frequent water taps. The campground is beautifully shaded by tall trees, providing a relaxing atmosphere. Plus, its location is fantastic—just a 2-minute drive to Cultus Lake and about 5-6 minutes to the Cultus Lake Waterpark. Highly recommend for a peaceful and enjoyable camping experience! （中文要点：洗手间干净维护好、淋浴+多处水龙头；大树遮荫氛围放松；开车2分钟到湖、5-6分钟到水上乐园）

reviews.author: Dakota134
reviews.text: Was a great place to camp. But it's 35 a night and 6$ to book. A tiny bundle of firewood it 9$. If you choose your site correctly it can be great. I recommend away from the lake. The hi way down near water is very noisy all night and further back in the bush the campsites are not so tight together. The fishing off the docks is unreal, the swimming is pretty good too but some spots have a lot of weeds. The bathrooms at campsites are hit and miss. They have free showers. Also there's several camp officer trucks that literally go by every 5 minutes in the evening at about 40 to 50kph. So does eveveryone else. I would for sure stay again. Thought it was pricey tho. We stayed at clear creek campground and maple bay campground. The maple bay site we first got given was I believe number 58. We refused it. It was about 15 feet from a huge sewer system and the stink was overwhelming. By this time it was almost 8. We decided we with all the kids we would get a hotel. We went to get a refund and they refused. Date of experience: August 2016. （中文要点：住过 Clear Creek 和 Maple Bay；选位得当就很棒，建议选远离湖的（湖边公路整夜吵）；码头钓鱼一流；Maple Bay 58号营位离大型污水系统仅15英尺、臭气熏天而拒住，申请退款被拒）

We were very disappointed with Entrance Bay campground on Cultus Lake. It is a provincial campground and usually they are well maintained. There is no crosswalk from the campground to the beach and crossing the road is extremely dangerous. We asked if there was a safer crossing and was told by a park attendant that most people drive. The beach is literally right across the road and we were not going to drive our RV after setting up camp. The beach itself is filthy and there does not look like there is any attempt to clean it up. Geese are everywhere and both the foreshore and the beach are covered with geese feces, feathers, old band aids and debris. All of this would wash into the lake after a rainfall. No wonder you can get the itch from swimming there. （中文要点：Entrance Bay 营地到沙滩没有人行横道、过马路极危险；沙滩布满鹅粪、羽毛、创可贴和垃圾无人清理；怀疑游泳发痒与此有关）

reviews.title: Excellent Place for First Time Campers!
reviews.text: For as long as we've lived in BC (10+years), we never had the (car) camping bug bite us. But now that we have 2 kids - aged 10 and 7 - we thought it might be nice as a relaxing family experience. Being our first time, we didn't want to go anywhere far in case we decided to come home early (rain, illness, etc.). So for us, our options were Cultus Lake or Golden Ears because they're close in proximity. We went with Cultus Lake in the end because we'd been to the Adventure Park numerous times so we knew the area well enough plus it's a 20-minute drive to Chilliwack. Pros - Entrance Bay is the first campground and closest to the Gatehouse. - Single showers but nice and hot; 3 flush toilets x 2 washroom facilities - Saw the park operators a few times per day emptying bins, etc. - I don't believe there's a bear issue here because some of the bins were right beside campsites. - Beach/day use area is large. Lots of picnic tables, parking, 2 docks. - Swimmer's Itch > there was a warning but we didn't get anything. We did make sure to towel dry quickly and showered once done. - 20 minutes to Save On Foods, McDonald's, Panago Pizza. Cons - You do have to cross the busy highway to get to the beach areas - No dedicated bike pathways; kids rode around the campground so not sure if it was worth bringing all of our bikes - No dish sinks - Beach/day use had a lot of goose poo so wear your flip flops everywhere. I would definitely come back. The benefit of this location is proximity to Chilliwack, I didn't need to bring 2 coolers of food and drink. We could've driven to Save On Foods and gotten everything fresh. One night, we actually didn't want what we brought for dinner so we picked up Panago Pizza in town and dined by lantern at our campsite (fire ban in place). For some, that's not 'true camping' but whatever. We had a relaxing time with nature altogether as a family. （中文要点：首次露营家庭选 Entrance Bay；淋浴热水足、无熊患、日间沙滩大；缺点：去沙滩要过繁忙公路、无自行车道、无洗碗槽、沙滩鹅粪多穿拖鞋、游泳发痒预警但擦干身体可避免；20分钟到 Chilliwack 补给方便）

reviews.title: Horrible campsite
reviews.text: I booked Delta Grove through the Discover Camping website for a week in July of this year, then we managed to get a last minute water site for 3 nights on Mothers Day which we were pretty excited about since we'd never camped here before. I am so happy we went because as soon as we got home, we cancelled for July! First of all, I'm not sure why the website shows that the campground is booked solid from now until the end of summer because we were one of only four occupied sites throughout our stay so we pretty much had the place to ourselves. Other reviews raved about the water sites... either these people have never camped before or they're delusional. We stayed at site D16 and there is a steep embankment leading to a small rocky area big enough for a couple of chairs so the water is not accessable if you have mobility issues and can be unsafe if you have small children. Additionally you will only have a peek-a-boo view of the water from your site through the trees. Other water sites are similar but it seems the higher the site number, the less of an embankment you will have to deal with so if you must stay here, opt for sites in the 30+ waterfront zone. Discover Camping park map shows the outhouse as being located directly across from D16 which it is not, it is actually on the other side of D18 and across the road from D19. A small detail but important for someone who's tenting as we were and might need to use the facilities at night. Traffic from the road is LOUD... and yes you can hear it clearly from the water sites... all of them. We walked down the park and there is no tuning it out. It's quieter at our house! The lake was peaceful while we were there (no motor boats) so i can only imagine how loud it gets at this campground in the summer with a full park, water sports and traffic combined. No thank you. It was great that there was no fire ban in place yet as having a campfire was the highlight of this trip although park staff questioned us about where we got our wood (we brought a trunk full from home in our second vehicle in order to avoid buying it at $25 a bundle) but if you're bringing a second vehicle be prepared to pay an extra $12 a night and there is no off road parking here so unloading and parking somewhere else is not an option. There is no play park for kids and not really a close public beach area for those campers who don't have a water site, although there are beach access trails if you're up for a small hike. Washrooms are clean and well maintained but then again, the campsite was empty so i'm not sure what it's like during high season. Park staff circulates often, the female rangers are personable and friendly but the males have ego issues. In short, if you're looking for a base camp to place your head at night while spending most of your time away from this place, (keeping in mind that Giggle Ridge and the water slides don't open until June 8th this year) it might be tolerable but if you're looking for a peaceful getaway, I would not recommend camping at Delta Grove. （中文要点：D16湖畔营位实为陡坡下到小石滩，行动不便/带幼儿危险，树后只能瞥见湖；湖畔营位号越大坡越缓（建议30+号湖畔区）；旱厕实际位置与官网地图不符；公路噪音连湖畔营位也躲不掉；第二辆车每晚加收$12且无路外停车；无儿童游乐场）
